name: BEML Land Assets Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2021, BEML Land Assets 
Ltd was formed by Demerger of Identified surplus / non-core assets of BEML Limited[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
a) BLAL is an offshoot of BEML, formed through a 1:1 ratio share issue to existing BEML shareholders. The Government of India is strategically disinvesting 26% of its equity stake in BEML Limited and transferring management control. Management believes separating and placing BEML's non-core assets into an independent entity will facilitate this process and unlock business value.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of -57.9% over last 3 years.
